deviations: split supplied by the benchmark (60/20/20, seed 42, train rows dirty, val/test rows clean) instead of the upstream random split
remove_large_cat and remove_all_na computed on training rows only (upstream: all rows)
test rows not passed to init_parameters; imputation step presence decided on train+val; test cache filled after the search
no per-epoch test evaluation (upstream only records it, selection unchanged); best epoch snapshot also stores the fitted transformation functions
label encoder fitted on train+val labels (upstream: all labels)
regression extension (not in the paper): linear head with 1 output, MSELoss on standardized target, R^2 replaces accuracy in early stopping

gradient clipping wired up (upstream declares grad_clip but never uses it): end-model gradient L2 norm clipped to 1.0 before every SGD step incl. the virtual step, pipeline-probability gradient clipped to the same norm before every Adam step
non-finite entries of the pipeline-probability gradient set to 0 before the Adam step
search space restricted to missing-value imputation and outlier cleaning
input: dirty training matrix in the canonical encoding with missing cells kept
soft pipeline output of the training rows exported without input clamp; test split untouched
